name: dev.leadrails/mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for LeadRails. Lets MCP-aware agents (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, …) read and manage sources / destinations / routes / events through your LeadRails workspace.

environmentVariables.name: LEADRAILS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for your LeadRails workspace. Generate at https://app.leadrails.dev/settings/api-keys.

environmentVariables.name: LEADRAILS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.leadrails.dev/v1; override for staging or self-hosted.
